449.flavor: 主要在白天活动。因为沙漠的夜晚会降温，所以会钻到沙子的深处睡觉。

450.flavor: 生气的时候非常凶暴。会喷出储存在体内的沙子来引发沙尘暴。

451.flavor: 用尾巴上带毒的钩爪袭击对手。一旦被夹住，毒素就会扩散开来，导致全身无法动弹。

452.flavor: 虽然狰狞凶猛到被人们称为沙之恶魔，但在河马兽面前却表现得低调温顺。

453.flavor: 毒素在稀释后能制成药品。它是制药公司的吉祥物，广受众人的欢迎。

454.flavor: 制服了猎物之后，便会呱呱地发出胜利的欢呼。与蟾蜍王是相近的物种。

455.flavor: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

456.flavor: 用发光的尾鳍引诱猎物。白天会在海面附近，到了夜里就向海的深处移动。

457.flavor: 像是爬行一样在深海的海底游泳。鳍上发出的充满幻想的光就像是夜空的星星。

458.flavor: 混在铁炮鱼的大群里游泳。受到敌人袭击的时候，会和铁炮鱼们并肩作战。

459.flavor: 雪笠怪肚子上结出来的口感好似冰棍的树果是伽勒尔的火红不倒翁们的最爱。

460.flavor: 会引发暴风雪的宝可梦。只要它摇动巨大的身体，周围立刻会变得一片雪白。

461.flavor: 通过用爪子留下记号来与伙伴联络。据说记号的种类有５００种以上。

462.flavor: 人们认为，它是因为受到特殊磁场的影响，身体的分子构造发生了变化，才进化成这样的。

463.flavor: 舌头的灵巧程度甚至不输给人手，没有它做不到的事。相反，手指却相当笨拙，

464.flavor: 用护具弹开敌人的攻击，在对手畏缩时用自己引以为傲的钻头贯穿对方。

465.flavor: 栖息的地域越是温暖，藤蔓生长得就越快。藤蔓变长后，它会亲手将其扯断使其变短。

466.flavor: 发电量在电气宝可梦当中属于最高级别。可以从尾巴尖端释放高压电流。

467.flavor: 由于栖息在火山口，因此身体逐渐变得像火山一样，还长着类似岩浆库的器官。

468.flavor: 被称为会带来恩惠的宝可梦，从很久很久以前开始，人们就视它为吉祥之物。

469.flavor: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

470.flavor: 尾巴好似锐利的刀刃，锋利得无与伦比，连大树都能一斩为二。

471.flavor: 冰伊布释放出的冷气能制造出粉状的雪。这使它受到各个滑雪场的热烈欢迎。

472.flavor: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

473.flavor: 它的力量就如外表那样强大。天气越是寒冷，它的冰牙就会长得越粗、越长、越结实。

474.flavor: 有人说它是通过追加程序进化的，但关于它的改变是否真是进化，在学会中也存在着意见分歧。

475.flavor: 能够敏锐地感知到寻求帮助的感情，并且火速赶去援助对方。

476.flavor: 使用３个小部件获取食物，或是和敌人战斗。本体基本上只负责下命令。

477.flavor: 用腹部的嘴将猎物整个吞下。只会吃掉对方的魂魄，离去时会把肉体吐出来。

478.flavor: 会吐出零下５０度的冷气冻住猎物，并把它们带回自己的巢穴，整齐地摆成一排。

479.flavor: 会用由离子构成的身体潜入各种各样的机器里。最喜欢恶作剧吓人。

480.flavor: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

481.flavor: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

482.flavor: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

483.flavor: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

484.flavor: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

485.flavor: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

486.flavor: 据说它用各种各样的材料制作了宝可梦后，把大陆移动到了现在的位置。

487.flavor: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

488.flavor: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

489.flavor: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

490.flavor: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

491.flavor: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

492.flavor: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

493.flavor: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

494.flavor: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

495.flavor: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

496.flavor: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

497.flavor: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

498.flavor: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

499.flavor: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

500.flavor: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

501.flavor: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

502.flavor: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

503.flavor: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

504.flavor: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

505.flavor: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

506.flavor: 比普通的小孩子还要聪明许多。对于得到的关爱和受到的伤害都不会忘怀。

507.flavor: 覆盖在身上的黑色体毛既厚又有弹性，甚至能把尖锐的牙齿也反弹回去。

508.flavor: 以自己气派的胡须为傲。据说，每只个体在族群中的地位，就是根据胡须长度来决定的。

509.flavor: 会用可爱的动作让对手放下戒心，趁对方靠过来时冷不防地用爪子猛抓，然后得意地大笑。

510.flavor: 和猾大狐争抢地盘。能够悄无声息地从背后偷偷靠近猎物。

511.flavor: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

512.flavor: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
